response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 1","severity":"major","source_quote":"“swam those twenty-five miles”","suggested_fix":"Replace “עשרים וחמשת המילים הללו” with “עשרים וחמישה המיילים האלה” (or another clear rendering of twenty-five miles).","translation_quote":"“שחה השחיין הנודע מתיו ווב את עשרים וחמשת המילים הללו”"},{"location":"Title; paragraphs 4–6","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Past Redemption Point”; “past Redemption Point”; “the ‘Past Redemption Point’ of your life”","suggested_fix":"Use a consistent rendering that retains the redemption concept, such as “מעבר לנקודת הגאולה” in the title and corresponding occurrences in the text, rather than “נקודת האל־חזור”.","translation_quote":"Title: “מעבר לנקודת האל־חזור”; paragraphs 4–6: “מעבר לנקודת האל־חזור” and “נקודת האל־חזור”"},{"location":"Paragraph 3","severity":"minor","source_quote":"“standing in safety round him, safe themselves”","suggested_fix":"Change “בטוחים בעצמם” to “בטוחים” or “במקום בטוח” to convey that the onlookers themselves were safe.","translation_quote":"“אלפים עמדו בבטחה סביבו וראו אותו נעלם, בטוחים בעצמם אך חסרי יכולת לעזור לו”"},{"location":"Paragraph 5","severity":"minor","source_quote":"“half dreaming”","suggested_fix":"Replace “חצי ישן” with “כמו בחלום” or “בהקיץ למחצה” to convey drifting while half-dreaming, not simply being half-asleep.","translation_quote":"“להיסחף, חצי ישן”"}],"findings_complete":true,"passed":false,"score":84}
